Welcome to LinkStage. Your privacy is important to us. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data in accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

We collect data such as your name, email address, educational institution and professional information (in the case of students) to enable the use of platform features, such as internship applications and communication between users.
Your personal data is only shared with relevant entities (Institutions and Advisors) when you initiate an application or interaction on the platform. We do not sell your data to third parties.
For any privacy-related questions or to exercise your rights, users may contact the project coordination through their respective Educational Institution.
